user.title: Set up Clicker
user.description: Clicker learns and sends RF remote codes through your ESPHome radios. Radios are found automatically.

import_rf_device_manager.name: Import from RF Device Manager
import_rf_device_manager.description: Copies the devices and codes stored by the RF Device Manager integration into Clicker, re-encoding each code. Devices Clicker already has (by name) are skipped, so it is safe to run again.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends one of a Clicker device's commands through its radio. Sends on one radio go out one at a time.

device.name: Device
device.description: The Clicker device, by name or id.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command, by name or id.

frames_on_air.name: Frames on air
frames_on_air.description: How many frames to send this time, instead of the command's own setting.

set_assumed_state.name: Set assumed state
set_assumed_state.description: Corrects what Home Assistant assumes a Clicker fan or light is doing, without sending anything. Use it when a device and Home Assistant disagree, for example after a remote press was missed.

percentage.name: Speed
percentage.description: The speed, as a percentage; 0 means off.
